CustomField.description: Id (as text) of another task this one is manually marked as waiting on, chosen by the user in the New Task modal when Status = Waiting. Not a real Lookup because the platform does not allow Task to be a lookup target on the Activity object (self-referencing Task relationships are unsupported) - same workaround as Parent_Task__c. Independent of the subtask-chain system: this is for ad hoc manually-created tasks, not template-generated chain steps.
CustomField.label: Waiting On Task
